evidence.quote: ECTS credits 180 Period of study 8 Semester(s)
English (first to fourth semesters) and German (partially in the third semester and fourth semester, completely in the fifth to eighth semesters)
Submit application via Please apply via uni-assist.
Application International applicants must apply via uni assist.
Academic admission requirements Secondary school leaving certificate (verified copy of the original with a verified English or German translation of the original)

English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: TOEIC: 785 Reading: 385 Listening: 400 Speaking: 160 Writing: 150 TOEFL iBT (before 2026): 80 Reading: 20 Listening: 20 Speaking: 20 Writing: 20 TOEFL iBT Home Edition (before 2026): 80 Reading: 20 Listening: 20 Speaking: 20 Writing: 20 IELTS Academic: 6

Requirements English language skills are at least at level B2 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). We accept the following examinations, among others: TOEFL Internet-based (iBT) with at least 80 points IELTS (International English Language Testing System) at least at band 6.0 Test of English for International Communication (TOEIC) Cambridge English (ESOL)

notes: The pages do not state a tuition fee for non-EU students; the only fee statement is 'Tuition fees per semester None' and a semester contribution of approx. 350 EUR (which is not tuition). The German-language deadline '15 June' for international applicants has no year, so it is recorded as a recurring deadline. The application deadline quote is for international applicants. The programme page's own URL is the DAAD page; the HTW Dresden page provides additional confirmation. A semester contribution of 364.03 EUR (part-time 137.23 EUR) is stated for re-registration, not as tuition.
